description: Heat.gov - National Integrated Heat Health Information System (NIHHIS) is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention; NOAA, National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration. This portal provides authoritative and usable resources on the subject of heat health. At a glance, users can see real-time estimates of the number of people in the U.S. that are under extreme heat advisories, watches, and warnings issued by the National Weather Service. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Extreme Heat. Assets: People. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
